features.quote: End-of-episode resolution turn: after termination, send one final message explaining the test suite was broken and the model's work was not at fault, and log the response.
features.justification_quote: Epistemically you don't know if this matters; it costs one API call, and the response is itself data (does the model's state visibly resolve?)

features.quote: Minimum effective exposure: power analysis from the pilot; don't run more spiral-episodes than the analysis requires.
features.justification_quote: You're in the awkward position of inflicting the thing you're studying, under uncertainty about whether there's anyone to inflict it on.
